description: This file defines a class 'RecentlyEditedTracker' that tracks recently edited ranges and documents within a VSCode workspace, managing their lifecycle, overlap, and retrieval.

classes.name: RecentlyEditedTracker
classes.description: A class that tracks recently edited ranges and documents in a VSCode workspace, with methods for inserting, removing, and retrieving recent edits.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the tracker, sets up event listeners for document changes, and starts cleanup interval.

methods.name: insertRange
methods.description: Inserts a new edited range, merging with existing ranges if overlapping, and updates internal state.

methods.name: insertDocument
methods.description: Adds a document to the recently edited documents list if not already present.

methods.name: removeOldEntries
methods.description: Removes ranges that are older than the stale time threshold.

methods.name: _getContentsForRange
methods.description: Retrieves the content of a specified range from a file via the IDE interface.

methods.name: getRecentlyEditedRanges
methods.description: Returns the list of recently edited ranges with file paths.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes event listeners and clears internal data.
